projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Policy Text

bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided public policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules with Python re to extract organization and date spans, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization steps on the company report document collection and inspected query terms and example matches with guidance.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using Matplotlib.
As part of supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization steps on public product review excerpts and inspected organization-name and date examples with guidance.
As part of supervised research, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
